description: This file defines a JavaScript module 'aclviewer' that manages access control role views, including functionality for viewing roles, saving changes, handling display toggling, and making asynchronous requests to server endpoints within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous request to display the ACL role editing interface for a specified role and module.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes form data and sends it via an asynchronous request to save ACL role modifications.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles server response after save, re-displaying the role view with updated data.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the response data in the designated HTML element and indicates completion.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles failure in AJAX requests by displaying error status.

methods.name: toggleDisplay
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a specified UI element, hiding or showing based on current state.

methods.name: hideDisplay
methods.description: Hides a specified HTML element and its associated link.

methods.name: showDisplay
methods.description: Shows a specified HTML element and hides its associated link.
